backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing articles and user profiles with access control, providing queries and updates for fetching, filtering, and saving profile and article data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two publishing‑related features to affected frontend files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted list summarizing major frontend files and their roles in routing, UI components, hooks, and pages.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base config defining light and dark theme CSS variables and applying global styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry file loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app routing setup using TanStack Router with theme provider, layout shell, and page routes including upload.
frontend/src/components/articles/Article: Clickable article preview card showing summary, date, promotion badge, and optional content snippet.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppHead: App header with logo, global search input, and upload button using shared search context.
frontend/src/components/home/BreakingBan: Auto-rotating breaking news banner displaying headline and navigation to the current article.
frontend/src/components/layouts/TabShell: Layout wrapper providing app header, bottom tabs, and a shared search context for all pages.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Botto: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with tab buttons that navigate and highlight based on the current route.
frontend/src/components/news/NewsFilters: Provides promotion and category dropdown filters for news, updating parent state on selection changes.
frontend/src/components/profile/LoginBut: Displays a login/logout button using Internet Identity and handles authentication logic with status states.
frontend/src/components/profile/Promotio: Shows a list of promotion checkboxes and saves the user's favorite promotions to their profile.
frontend/src/components/promotions/Promo: Displays a promotion logo image in various sizes based on the promotion name.
Renders a rumor article row showing status, promotion badge, summary, and extracted source info.
frontend/src/components/rumors/StatusPil: Shows a styled label indicating rumor status such as confirmed, likely, or false.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useArticleActions.ts: Provides functions to save articles, update reading history, and check saved status for the current user.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context, handling login, logout, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating articles and user profile data through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTabMemory.ts: Stores and retrieves the last visited path per tab to maintain navigation state.
frontend/src/hooks/useThemeMode.ts: Syncs theme with user profile preferences and provides a toggle that persists theme changes.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and custom CSS variables for light/dark themes and semantic colors, plus utility classes for article status styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminApprovalPage.tsx: Empty placeholder page for admin approval features.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUploadArticlePag: Empty placeholder page for admin article upload functionality.
frontend/src/pages/ArticleDetailPage.tsx: Displays a full article with image, metadata, sharing, and save functionality, loading data via queries.
frontend/src/pages/EventDetailPage.tsx: Shows details for a single event article with date and content lookup via article queries.
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: Lists all event-category articles with search support and navigation to event detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Homepage showing breaking news, latest articles, trending stories, and search results using article queries.
frontend/src/pages/MatchDetailPage.tsx: Displays placeholder match details within an event and provides navigation back to the event.
frontend/src/pages/NewsPage.tsx: Lists news articles with promotion/category filters and integrated search results.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page showing identity info, preferences, saved articles, and reading history with authentication checks.
frontend/src/pages/RumorsPage.tsx: Displays rumor-category articles with search support, loading states, and a refresh option.
Handles authenticated article uploads with image validation, previews, form state, and publish submission logic.
frontend/src/utils/errorMessage.ts: Normalizes various error shapes into a user-friendly message string.
frontend/src/utils/imageDataUrl.ts: Validates image files for type and size and converts them to data URLs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Stores project state, features, issues, and the pending request to fix publish authorization.
